rows.label: bf08190100_0010
rows.name:
Blades are born from cores,
and Blades become Divine Beasts...

rows.label: bf08190100_0020
rows.name:
The Divine Beast, in
turn, nurtures life...

rows.label: bf08190100_0030
rows.name: And someday births new Core Crystals.

rows.label: bf08190100_0040
rows.name: The cycle of life known as Blades...

rows.label: bf08190100_0050
rows.name: Such is the law ordained by God.

rows.label: bf08190100_0060
rows.name:
And it was an object of worship
in the ancient kingdom of Iira.

rows.label: bf08190100_0080
rows.name: stood in awe of the greatness of Divine Beasts,

rows.label: bf08190100_0090
rows.name:
It was a nation that sought coexistence
between humans and Blades born from them.
